fieldValues.title: Every working group has a review date, and its report proposes its own future
fieldValues.move: A group's charter carries a review date. At that date the cycle report proposes renew, amend, merge or lay down, with reasons, and the owner session receives it as a decision, so the set of groups is reviewed one group at a time and the structure is revised iteratively rather than redesigned. For agent seats the review is of the mandate (brief, prompt, model), not rotation of the seat (vignette cb6c5175).
fieldValues.does_not_fix: It does not say what the right groups are. It does not by itself reduce the cost of running groups (SP for routines cost, 5959f5fb), though laying a group down is one way to.
fieldValues.falsifier: Every review comes back 'renew, unchanged' for several rounds; or reviews pile up unreceived, which is the pause rule's silence at a slower pace.
source_ref: muDemocracy.org/reference/Delegation in historic small democracy.md (Quaker laying down; QFP appointment minutes with term and end date; report-back element 8)
fieldValues.return_when: There is only one working group, or groups are short-lived by design.
